note: Ground-floor hall of the first pronouns (je, tu, il, moi, lui, ce, cela, ceci...). Pronouns have no grammatical gender here; the only noun, rien, is a man on the right. Divider null. Grouped scene: two men seated on the bench by the window, a girl at the tea table, people at different depths on the rug, a cellist seated in front. The white door on the far left goes back to the questions room; the wooden staircase on the right climbs to the first floor.
